certainty: Words EMPTY (single-ligature item, per the KN Zb 36a-d precedent): Olivier (autopsy) reads one ligature AB 0̣8̣+04 (A dotted + TE), which he proposes to insert in the LA sign table as A 506bis; the dot at lower left is a stylus perforation from applying a control mark, NOT a numeral. Matsas's alternatives (ligature A 609, or new ligature AB 08 + A 303 followed by numeral 1 or 10) are superseded by the autopsy but recorded. Both component signs also exist in Cretan Hieroglyphic, so the LA attribution is NOT fully certain; it is reinforced by the exclusively-LA klasmatogram A 708 on the twin nodulus SA We 3.
source: Del Freo, Rapport 2001-2005, Colloquium Romanum (Pasiphae I), 2008, pp. 208-209 (received from M. Del Freo 2026-08-10, corpus/bronze/delfreo_rapports_pre2016/, sha 7ebba45a...); primary: Matsas, D. 2004, CMS V Suppl. 3, no. 343 (published there as SA We 2)
